# Separate login artwork

Generated with the built-in image generation tool. Both PNG assets preserve their transparent backgrounds and are imported separately by app/login/page.tsx.

## login-laptop.png

Use case: product-mockup. Create ONLY an isolated photorealistic silver laptop, no packages, no plant, no background objects, transparent background. Match laptop in user's attached OWEG vendor login reference. Open laptop in three-quarter view, screen almost facing camera but top edge slopes slightly down to right, visible silver base extending to right, black thin bezel. Laptop occupies entire frame with small padding, landscape 5:4. Screen shows clean OWEG vendor dashboard: green OWEG logo in white top left, deep emerald left navigation (Dashboard, Products, Orders, Inventory, Payments, Dispatch, Reports, Support), white main content, three metric cards with teal and yellow icons, green rising area line chart Sales Overview, Recent Orders table below. Soft realistic light, subtle floor contact shadow, crisp photographic texture. Entire laptop visible. No surrounding page UI, no white rectangle background, no watermark. Reference composition: screen left edge leans slightly right downward, keyboard visible as thin base along bottom. Keep screen content legible.

## login-packages.png

Use case: product-mockup. Create ONLY a stack of OWEG shipping packages for compositing behind a laptop in the user's attached login reference. Isolated on genuinely transparent background. No laptop, no screen, no login UI. Large warm tan kraft cardboard cube at upper left foreground with dark green OWEG wordmark centered on front, subtle registered mark and small green fragile/recycle handling symbols at bottom. Two smaller kraft boxes behind to right, another wide low carton at bottom. Small softly out-of-focus green houseplant behind boxes at far right. Match the original reference: front of main box almost facing camera with left side visible, photographic pale warm cardboard, soft daylight from left, muted depth of field. Portrait 4:5 composition, fully visible boxes inside boundaries, no additional text, no watermark. Scene will sit in center of white login page behind a laptop, keep most visual weight in upper middle, soft floor shadow only, clean transparent edges.
